Ready to stack your cash and rack up those hours? PostNL Zaltbommel is looking for a logistic employee to join our high-energy team! Lock in a solid 40-hour work week and seriously boost your bank account with some juicy shift allowances. If you love a fast-paced environment where you can work independently, keep moving, and crush your goals with a great team backing you up, this is your sign. Let’s get to work and make it happen!

What we offer
- Great salary of € 14,99
- Allowance: 20% and 30% after 10:00 PM
- Weekend allowance: 40% and 100%
- Your travel costs covered by us
- Opportunities to grow
- Flexibility in hours!

Who you are
As a logistic employee at PostNL Zaltbommel we ask the following:

- You speak Dutch and/or English;
- You have a car, scooter, or bike to get to work;
- You are available for a minimum of three days per week;
- You are flexible and available to work all two shifts: evening/night shift 20:00 – 05:00, night shift 01:30 – 10:00;
- You are able to work physical by moving roll containers full of packages;

What will you do
Get ready for action! As a logistic employee, you are the heartbeat of our depot. Trucks roll in and out constantly. Together with your team, you clear the way. You unload roll containers at a fast pace. Next, you park them in the right spot. Is a truck empty? Time to load it up with the correct containers! You keep the momentum going so drivers can hit the road fast. Since the schedule rotates, every shift brings new energy. Fast, fun, and never a dull moment! #baanraders

- Working days: Monday through Sunday.
- Working hours: evening/night shift 20:00 – 05:00, night shift 01:30 – 10:00.

Where will you work
As a logistic employee, you will be part of an international team. Together you will ensure each driver sends the correct roll containers out. As a warehouse employee at Zara in Enschede, you make sure all products are neatly and timely stored in the warehouse. You work 3 to 8 hours per week, split between Monday mornings and Thursday afternoons. Working hours are from 7:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 19:00. This job is perfect if you want flexible hours alongside your studies or another job. You join an enthusiastic team and take responsibility for your own tasks.
You start your day by unpacking deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and put everything in the right place in the warehouse. After that, you make sure the store always has enough stock. At the end of your shift, you help keep the warehouse tidy. You stay active the whole time and work together with your colleagues.
This job suits you if you want flexible work and enjoy being part of a team. Experience is not required. Apply quickly and make a difference in the heart of Enschede! ✨

- Experience is not required, but is a plus
- You are physically fit and like to take initiative
- Able to work independently and in a team
- You speak Dutch or English

- Spot recurring bottlenecks and turn them into better, more scalable ways of working, without losing the personal touch.

- Genuinely energized by setting up and improving processes, not just following them.
- Prior startup experience is a strong plus — this role requires someone who can shape a function, not just staff it.
